::: {.obsidian-resignation-letter}
:::

State the resignation in the first paragraph. Name the last
working day and give the notice period served.

# Thanks

Record your thanks for the opportunities and the support you
received. Keep the tone positive.

# Handover

State your commitment to the handover. Name the tasks you will
complete before you leave and the documentation you will leave
behind.

# Contact details

Give your personal contact details so the team can reach you
after your last day.
